bagPolicy.summary: Only clear bags up to 12" x 6" x 12" are allowed. Backpacks and non-clear bags or purses are not.
allowed: Clear plastic or vinyl PVC bags up to 12" x 6" x 12"
prohibited: Bags or purses that are not clear
bagPolicy.note: Approved medical bags and equipment are allowed after inspection. All bags are inspected at entry.

parking.summary: Official venue guidance provides event parking information; lists a rate starting at $10.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Mesa Amphitheatre. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: Official venue guidance says food and beverage concessions are available.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: For accessibility accommodations or special requests, call the box office at (480) 644-2560 at least two weeks before the event.

reEntry.summary: Re-entry is not permitted after you leave the venue.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Official venue guidance provides box-office information and lists hours of from 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Entry gates generally open 60 to 90 minutes before the show begins, and some VIP tickets include early entry. All bags are inspected by security at entry.
